heading: Thursday, March 6, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Alibaba QwQ-32B and Mistral AI Mistral OCR.

items.headline: Alibaba releases QwQ-32B reasoning model
items.summary: QwQ-32B is a 32B-parameter open-weight (Apache 2.0) reasoning model trained with reinforcement learning. Qwen claims performance comparable to the much larger DeepSeek-R1; it is on Hugging Face, ModelScope, Qwen Chat and the DashScope API.

items.headline: Mistral launches Mistral OCR document understanding API
items.summary: Mistral OCR is a document-understanding model and API that extracts text, tables, equations and images from documents, processing up to 2,000 pages per minute on a single node. Mistral reports an overall score of 94.89 in its internal benchmarks; pricing was about 1,000 pages per dollar.
